object_interaction_kinematics.description: Robot-object retargeting kinematic quality (paper Table II, robot-object rows on OMOMO). Hidden test: 12 held-out overhead box-carry demonstrations by planar humans of varied proportions, retargeted to a fixed planar humanoid. Penetration and foot skating are the hard-constraint side; contact preservation is the interaction benefit; pelvis-path and velocity errors guard motion fidelity. A method that fails any test instance or leaves the robot's joint/velocity limits receives the worst value of every metric.

penetration_duration.description: Fraction of frames in which some robot link penetrates the target-scene terrain or object by more than 1 cm.

max_penetration_cm.description: Deepest link penetration into the target-scene terrain or object over the trajectory (cm, capped at 30).

foot_skating_duration.description: Fraction of desired stance-foot frame pairs in which the robot foot moves faster than 1 cm/s.

max_foot_skating_cm_s.description: Maximum robot foot speed over desired stance-foot frame pairs (cm/s, capped at 300).

contact_preservation.description: Fraction of desired contact events (hand-object / hand-terrain contacts and planted feet on the terrain) where the robot point is within 2 cm of the target-scene contact surface.

pelvis_path_error_cm.description: Mean error of the robot pelvis displacement path relative to the demonstrated pelvis displacement (cm, capped at 100).

motion_velocity_error_cm_s.description: Mean keypoint velocity mismatch between the robot and the demonstration (cm/s, capped at 300).

object_interaction_kinematics._scale_note: The paper's rows below are Unitree G1 retargets of OMOMO (3D, real collision meshes); this gym is a scaled planar substitute, so cm-valued metrics are not on the paper's scale and the paper's object contact metric covers hands only (feet are pooled in here). They are kept for orientation, not as targets.

terrain_interaction_kinematics.description: Robot-terrain retargeting kinematic quality (paper Table II, robot-terrain rows on in-house MoCap). Hidden test: 12 held-out demonstrations of stepping up a ramp onto a platform while bracing a hand on a tall column. Contact covers the bracing hand and planted feet, as in the paper (hands, toes, heels).

augmented_interaction_kinematics.description: Interaction-preserving retargeting into modified scenes (paper Sec. III-B / App. C augmentation: object resized and initially displaced with an exponentially decaying offset per Eq. 14, or platform/column height changed). Hidden test: 12 held-out demonstrations (6 object, 6 terrain); the robot must act in the target scene while the demonstration was recorded in the source scene. Same metrics, computed against the target scene.

The omniretarget value below is this gym's measured reference, recorded for orientation.
